description: This PHP class 'Skill' extends 'ListableDisplayField' and defines metadata for displaying skill-related data within the OrangeHRM reporting module. It provides methods to specify the associated DTO class, entity aliases, and fields relevant to the Skill report display.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Represents a displayable report field for skills, specifying associated DTO class, entity aliases, and relevant fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) class associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in reporting queries related to skills.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields that this display field represents, specifically the employee number.
